The text teaches: *"So there were many different needs, and Jay, being kind-hearted and generous, tried to fulfil them all."* This reflection invites us to look past superficial conventions into the living reality of the present moment. By cultivating patience, virtue, and clear discernment, the mind discovers an unshakable inner refuge. It is like It is like turning off a loud motor and resting in the natural silence of the room. Walk the noble path with confidence and peace.

source: Book: The Dhamma and the Real World - Ajahn Pasanno and Ajahn Amaro
title: The Dhamma and the Real World
